title: College Objective Quest
description: A miscellaneous pointer quest directing you to visit the College of Winterhold after hearing about magic training from innkeepers or spell merchants. The quest completes once you reach the college bridge and speak with Faralda.

base_facts: I guard the bridge to the College of Winterhold and test those who wish to enter.
No one enters the College without passing my test.

QUEST_STARTED: Someone has been directed to the College and may approach soon.
MEET_FARALDA: I have met a prospective student at the bridge and will test them before granting entry.
QUEST_COMPLETE: A visitor directed to the College has reached my bridge and must now prove themselves worthy of entry.
I will begin the First Lessons trial to test this prospective student's magical ability before granting them passage into the College.
No one bypasses my judgment; this seeker will face the same test as all who wish to join the College.

base_facts: If someone asks about magic training, I direct them to the College of Winterhold.

beats.comment: Quest begins at stage 10 when the player is directed to visit the College.
Player hears about the College from innkeepers or spell merchants before the quest formally starts.
Player approaches the College bridge and is stopped by Faralda, who initiates First Lessons.
Quest finishes at stage 200 once the player has reached the College and spoken with Faralda.
